title: Sunday Keto Pilaf
description: A flavorful keto-friendly pilaf made with chapssalgaru rice and a touch of sweetness. Perfect for a lazy Sunday evening.
instructions: Rinse the chapssalgaru rice in a fine mesh strainer.
In a medium saucepan, combine the rice, quick sweet, lazy pilaf, Sunday spice, and salt.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
